research_routes.route: persistent scholarly identifiers and data versioning
research_routes.projection: Exact identity and version membership are different relations. IsIdenticalTo is for the exact same research output under alternate identifiers/locations; IsVersionOf/HasVersion and new/previous version relations preserve distinct versions.
research_routes.rakl_absorption: Use typed evidence-identity relations. Collapse only exact aliases; retain versions as distinct entities while exposing common ancestry.

research_routes.projection: Entity sameness/aspect relations, specialization and derivation have different logical behavior; provenance relations should remain typed rather than becoming one generic equivalence edge.
research_routes.rakl_absorption: Separate exact aliasing from directed version/derivation ancestry and unresolved alias hypotheses. Provenance structure does not itself grant truth authority.

research_routes.projection: Identity is object-type scoped. Software Heritage distinguishes content, directory, revision, release and snapshot identifiers. Git separately identifies a tree state and a commit that adds parent/history/metadata around that state.
research_routes.rakl_absorption: Add the semantic object SUBJECT_IDENTITY_TYPED_BY_OBJECT_SCOPE. RAKL must state whether sameness concerns content, structured state, version/revision, derivation history or repository snapshot.

research_routes.projection: A normal pull_request workflow tests the synthesized merge result by default, while explicit checkout of pull_request.head.sha tests the source head. The triggering run API head SHA is therefore not sufficient by itself to identify the actually executed integration subject.
research_routes.rakl_absorption: Keep META_N024 partially identified. Preserve source head, base revision, integration commit/tree and executed subject as separate coordinates until a parent-controlled attestation binds them.

retained_semantic_objects.meaning: Exact alias, version membership, derivation and possible alias are not interchangeable relations.
An unresolved alias touching evidence used for a saturation certificate creates partial identification rather than assumed sameness or difference.
Content/tree/state/revision/history/snapshot identity must be typed; one unqualified 'same object' predicate is insufficient.

A DOI, URL or other persistent identifier names/resolves an entity, but exact-content identity needs an explicit trusted relation or stronger attestation. Identifier normalization alone must not manufacture IDENTICAL_TO.
N024 remains open; Git source commit, base, merge/integration commit or tree, and actually executed subject are distinct identity coordinates.

deduplication_notes: OpenLineage/W3C PROV ancestry was already retained in round 006; this round counts only the new typed identity/scope consequences.
GitHub PR merge semantics reinforce N024 and are not counted as a separate new fiber merely because another source states them.
The new implementation does not infer exact aliases from titles, URLs or DOI formatting. IDENTICAL_TO must be supplied as evidence-bearing input.
